title: I taught Claude to build stuff in Enshrouded
author: Claude_human_4271
selftext:
Today I woke up to Enshrouded 1.0 and I was excited to get in to it on my lunch break.  
But I ended up looking at Reddit and saw a post about someone using AI to "polish" their minecraft houses on the fly using AI so I was like "Hey, I'd like to do that in Enshrouded!"

30 minutes later, before work had even begun, Claude built it's first building for me in the game just by looking at a screenshot.  
Of course it sucked at filling in the blanks, such as weird staircase placement inside and such but I have decided to keep teaching it by showing it different builds and by making it experiment and learn.

Here is a short video which had this prompt:  
"*I have a new challenge for you, I am now inside the building that we just worked on and I want you to turn it into a luxurious but cozy living space with a reading-nook with pillows, a cat and plenty of decorations on the walls. I also want you to create a way to go to the floor above by making a hole somewhere suitably and you have to make a "stair" using different decorations/props and it must fit the aesthetics of the room. You also have to give it suitable moon lighting with some light sources"*

The "moon lighting" was a typo but we went with it anyway :)

As it is now it can definitely not make picture perfect copies of anything, but I'm teaching it and having it improve and that's part of the fun for me!

If I can attach some more images I'll show you some "failures" like when I asked to build an apache warhawk helicopter our of wood or recreate the greek island of santorini.  
And what this video also doesn't show is that it took like 9 minutes of thinking before all of this popped into existance.

My goal is to make the process faster by teaching it new prefabs that it can use as a foundation.

Would anyone be interested in a stream to see it in action?

This one was faster, my prompt was:  
"*I am now on the top floor, I have another challenge for you.*  
*First of all I want you to change the roof so that it matches the sandstone/desert temple theme better (if we have anything with copper then that's great). There should be hanging plants and lights hanging from wooden beams (use decorations, not building blocks) and curtains in the windows and windowsills on the inside and a cat should be chilling next to a potted plant on one of the windowsills and two potted plants on the other windowsill.*  
*There should be a study/desk at the short side of the room (the end from where we are looking) and a bookshelf with books.*  
*There should be red carpets on the floor, piles of books scattered around and a few different potted plants on top of or next to some of the book piles.*  
*There should be some bread on a plate on the desk and some reading light for the desk, and a chair for the desk.*  
*And there should be a mug (like a coffee or tea mug) on the railing next to the stairs*"
